profile.org_note: Three tiers: CEO and President Todd Chachere, then regional Presidents (Perry's internal title is City President: Matthew Gerdes for Houston, Billy Shirley for Dallas-Fort Worth, Chris Little for Central Texas and Florida), then 19 Division Presidents (e.g. Garrison Taska for most of Florida, Brad Shee for Jacksonville). Land deals run through the land affiliates PH Land Holdings, LLC and PH Land Holdings HOU, LLC, whose officers are Chachere, CFO and Treasurer Eric Bakk, CLAO Michael Brisch, SVP Land Nick McIntyre and the Texas City Presidents Gerdes, Shirley and Little; those are the land decision-makers.
profile.summary: Private, woman-owned Houston builder founded in 1967, now in nine markets: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin and San Antonio in Texas, and Jacksonville, Orlando, Tampa, Southeast and Southwest Florida. The company reports more than 73,000 homeowners served and more than 140 communities, and bought Jacksonville's MasterCraft Builder Group in December 2024. State records show it holds land through its own affiliates (PH Land Holdings) with a dedicated SVP Land, which suggests it owns and develops some of its lots rather than only buying finished lots in master plans; the Florida build-out is the newest likely call for lot capital.

people.title: SVP Land
people.source_title: Texas Comptroller franchise tax record, PH Land Holdings, LLC (taxpayer 32071457140): officers, 2026 report year
people.note: Only land-titled officer found. Not on the Perry Homes, LLC officer list itself. Whether he covers acquisition, development or both, and for which markets, is not stated. State record prints names in capitals; capitalisation here is ours.

Regional structure is not published as an org chart; it is built from 2020-2026 company releases plus the 2026 Texas officer list. Regions: Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Central Texas, Florida (incl. Jacksonville).
